title: RunPod job input (the value of "input" in POST /run)
description: Deliberately content-free: no prompt, no seed, no storage location, no callback URL. The worker exchanges the capability for the generation parameters and a one-time upload URL at POST /internal/jobs/{job_id}/claim, so RunPod job records never hold customer prompts. The gateway base URL comes from worker environment, never from job input.

job_id.description: Opaque native job id; doubles as the public request id carried to RunPod.

attempt.description: Submission attempt number. At most one infrastructure retry exists (policy max_infrastructure_retries = 1).

capability.description: Signed execution capability: base64url(JSON payload) + '.' + base64url(HMAC-SHA256). Payload fields: v, job_id, attempt, ops (['claim','complete']), model, exp (unix seconds). Opaque to the worker.

synthetic.description: True only for explicitly metered qualification/benchmark jobs, never for health checks.
